major_sections: Hours, pay, payroll deductions and direct deposit
Medical insurance / COBRA / workers compensation / life / dental / vision / retirement
Personal/sick leave, annual leave, holidays, unemployment, jury duty, funeral pay, military leave and FMLA
important_historical_rules: Direct deposit required within the first two weeks of employment.
Medical insurance eligibility generally began the first day of the month following 60 days of employment for eligible active full-time employees, subject to timely enrollment.
Personal/Sick Leave accrued at two hours per pay period, up to six days per year, after 30 days, with a stated 60-day maximum accrual.
FMLA ran concurrently with workers compensation leave and required the employee share of health/vision/dental premiums while on leave.
Workers compensation injuries were to be reported immediately to supervisor/person in charge/HR, with HR filing the claim.
The attendance system used a legacy 10-point termination threshold.
The EEO Program responsibility was assigned to Sheila Stallsworth in this version.
The handbook contained a grouped progressive-discipline framework (Groups A-D).
currentness_guardrail: Use the December 15, 2025 handbook and later signed/current policies for operational decisions. This 2017 source is historical evidence only.
